sens_en: to take off, to shed, to escape
origine_fr: 月, la chair, et 兑, écrit 丷, 口 et 儿, qui donnait autrefois le son mais se lit aujourd'hui duì. Au départ, 脱 veut dire perdre sa chair, maigrir. De la chair qui fond viennent « se détacher, ôter ».
origine_en: 月, flesh, plus 兑, written 丷, 口 and 儿, which once gave the sound but is now read duì. At first, 脱 meant losing flesh, growing thin. From flesh melting away come “to come off, to take off”.

phrase.pinyin: Jìn mén qián qǐng tuō xié.
phrase.en: Please take off your shoes before coming in.
